notes.title: 📜 Warcube Development Status ⭐Read Before You Buy!⭐
notes.content:
Hiya friends! It's been far too long since a post or update on Warcube, so let's talk! 🙂

First off, thank you for being SO patient with me 😌 
It really does mean a lot to me. Warcube is truly on my mind. I think about it every day, and I really want to finish it, and have every motivation to continue and do so. But development is officially on pause for right now.

As some of you may know, apart from life being it's usual busy (the joke is that I have like 3,348 kids by now lol) the game has been getting a huge restructuring. Like we're talking a complete foundational rebuild. This doesn't mean like crazy new graphics or anything like that, but more the *base* that the game is built on is getting changed. It's a bit like moving a house that's already been built. Which is especially tricky with a game like Warcube, that has almost 3 years of work and updates. But I feel (and some recent reviews certain support) that the game where it stands is broken. So my plan is to see if I can currently pause purchases of the game, and anyone who would like to take advantage of Steam's return policy won't offend me at all, I totally get it and would encourage you to 🙂 and if you have the game, don't worry you'll still be able to play it and will get first access to the Warcube revamp!

But don't get me wrong, I don't say this as an excuse, but a genuine reason as to why many of the reported bugs are starting to stack up. I'm definitely stretched more than thin between maintaining the old foundation, and building the new one. And if I'm being honest, like you, I'm way more excited in life about the future than the past 😄 (except when it comes to medieval stuff, I think current life could use a lot more trebuchets in it nowadays! Scifi trebuchets for the win!)

The new version of Warcube is going to play very similar and yet different than the current version. 
Worry not, the beloved slow motion epic combat and charming yells of your troops in battle is staying. But the sprawling world map currently in the game will be retired, and in it's place will be a new more manageable map that can be interacted with in more fun and meaningful ways. In addition, the game will become much more of a roguelite than it is currently, with replayability and being put into cool combat scenarios a key feature. And as everyone knows, I'm a huge fan of easter eggs and surprising people, so there will be plenty of things to discover 😉

And if you're ever wondering what the status of the game is
you can always head over to iswarcubeupdatingsoonornot.com to see! 

Another important reason the game is paused 
is that I have a some super fun projects in the works which I'm lucky to have more development support on than Warcube. Working on these projects helps me get better at working on Warcube. For example so far it's given me a chance to work on things like mission structure, special moves, localization, upgrading things in general, and customization! Which we can all agree are super great things I've struggled with integrated into Warcube across Early Access so far. And of course while a lot can change, unofficially I think it's only fair that people who have already purchased Warcube should get any game I make that comes out *before* Warcube, for free. All they'll have to do is ask me 🙂

One of those projects hasn't been officially announced yet, but since we're friends I'll give you a sneak peek 😜 I'd like you to meet Coin Hogs! A first person action game that takes place above the clouds, where you'll fly airships (that have trebuchets on them), siege castles in the sky, and take care of your home which also happens to be a tavern. If that sounds like your sort of thing, sign up here to get access to the alpha before anyone else 💪! The current Warcube Discord is also a great place to follow along!

Speaking of the Warcube Discord... 
(which is a super lovely place full of kind and caring people who are absolute warriors) Soon the server will be transitioning into a company server! Never would I have thought I'd have multiple games being made 😂 but here we are! So in a few weeks I'm proud to announce the Warcube Discord will officially become the JAM RASCALS Discord! It'll be the same fun place full of nice friends, questionably good puns, and great emojis! All Rascals welcome! 😁

As usual, I am very much still around 
and you're more than welcome to ask me questions about any of this stuff 😁 (and anything else, though questions like 'why are we here' are harder to answer). Thanks for going on this adventure with me, I'm excited for what's next, but let's not forget the GIF that started it all ✨

- craigz

notes.title: Summer Check-In!
notes.content:
Hiya Friends! 👋

Thanks for being patient with me these past few months, I wanted to give a quick status update to let you know that I'm alive and cranking along :D My hope is that I'll be able to do one of these every week or so showing off or at least talking about progress, because otherwise I turn into a hermit💪

Live view of me these past few months
https://i.imgur.com/MZBxlh5.jpg

Let me answer some quick questions I've gotten! ✍

Are you alive?!
In short. YES!

Is... is... is the GAME alive?!
YES! Though I have been slow because I've had the lucky opportunity to kick off a super secret project at the company I work at... more on that later 😉

So then what's going on...?
I'm working on reworking the backbone of the game, this will really end up changing how the game is played so much, and I'm starting with the map. Currently the map is this sort of vague hodge podge of exploration and wannabe sandbox style gameplay with a shaky form of progression. I'd like to shift it to something a little bit more clear, so whether you play for 10 hours straight or pop in every couple months you'll know exactly what to do. 

At it's core, the stages are going to be a bit staggered, where for example in this picture, you own the blue, and the white zones are levels ready to be played, and the red ones are levels you are not able to play yet. Of course you can still explore around some portions of the map that are not locked by a geographic reason (such as a bridge that gets raised once you take over the location), but by and large the map will "slowly" open up vs. always be open like how it is now. Also, worry not, there will still be secret locations 😉
https://i.imgur.com/Gsp18ds.png

My hope is that changing the map will help me create a process for more objectively working on the game 💪

Next post will be about tentative changes to how armies and NPC's work ✨

What do you think of the potential changes to the map? Like, disklike, indifferent? Let me know! As well as any questions or topics you'd like me to cover! 😁

Cheers,
craigz

notes.title: Update 55! 🎉
notes.content:
Introducing "Normal Update Numbers" I've ditched boring update names like "0.4.15v1" for something that you know, sounds like a human wrote it 😉 Like a good old regular number that corresponds with what update it is! Though I will say, I don't actually know if this is my 55th update, but it's gotta be somewhere around there, or even more (we should ask Myriad 🤷‍♂️)

State Of Warcube
Welcome to the very first 'State Of Warcube' post. After nearly a year of no major update, I feel this is totally necessary. But before I start, I just want to say how incredibly thankful I am to every person who reached out to me on every platform (specially my Discord fam) with encouragement, kind words, and gentle prods of 'when will you update things?' as well as the ever unique 'hello?' (looking at you Bup). Suffice to say it's probably easier if I give a timeline of the past year to better put things into perspective. But to be succinct for you TL;DR folks out there: I really broke the game and started also working full-time.

1. November 2018: Was working on my first boss fight and physically moving states
2. December 2018: Moved, published a beta build, and started a full-time job.
3. January-March 2019: Broke the game by upgrading unity and not backing things up, like a fool
4. April - August 2019: Patched nearly every broken scene in the game to get it where things were roughly before.
5. Sept - December 2019: Worked way through backlog of bugs amidst full-time job. Again, I really struggle with time management at this point.
6. January - February 2020: Had another kid, finished fixing the arena, publishing beta builds again.
7. Now: Published the first of many updates for the 2020 year, featuring basically everything the game had in it before, as well as a few new things ;) 

Early Access
I've recently gone through and looked through my original Early Access descriptions on Steam (oof) and have decided I need to revamp them to better communicate my goals with the game, and my sincerity to finishing it. Everyone who knows me will understand the grit I have with finishing projects, and also my complete paralysis that comes from wanting to DO EVERYTHING ALL THE TIME. This is on my list to do for next week 😁 (good timing with your message Myriad!)So bear with me, and if my new descriptions don't fit your experience with owning the game these past few years, let me know :)

Big Stuff
- Arena mode is back
- New start screen
- Mac version is stalled for a bit due to some new build criteria via Apple

Small Stuff
- A million bugs have been fixed
- Slight performance improvements in large levels

How You Can Help
I'm adding a new section to help guide all the incredibly passionate people I've met who just want to help. Sometimes this will be a useful section, other times it wont. BUT. Right now, I could REALLY use help identifying other REALLY obnoxious bugs in the game, I'm not talking about the occasional clipping through walls and stuff, more the things that happen that really ruin the game while playing it. Here's some information on how to best describe a bug (to better help me fix it!). Or even just providing images and succinct descriptions is VERY helpful, similar to what Hedgie did here.

Or list some details in the #issues-and-bugs channel of the Discord Server. I'm a little behind on logging them just a heads up :D

Bottom Paragraph
Oh hey! You've made it to the bottom paragraph! Boy are you in for a treat ;) this is the little section where I just say hi. To you specifically. And this time I just want to take the time to say thank you. Thank you for being patient with me, thank you for believing in me, and for really being the kind of friend, player, fam a developer really appreciates :) making Warcube has changed my life in so many ways, and being able to connect with REAL people who are REALLY passionate about life in some way, is the biggest source of encouragement to me. So hey, have a great day... OR RATHER... have a great week! Wake up tomorrow and dig into life, it's certainly strange and wonderful (even amidst The Great Plague™)

-craigz

Tactical Build Menu!
Introducing the Tactical Build menu! :D press and hold 'T' to open the tactical build menu. From here you can call in troops, place structures and I'm still trying to figure out what the 3rd thing should be :P

I gotta say... this tactical build menu is REALLY bringing the game into a new direction. One that I'm pumped to say is super in line with what I hope the game to be, and after playing with it, I hope you'll think so TOO! :D there's some issues to work out with it, but give it a play and let me know what you think! :D 

Here's my big questions

    What would be some other fun things to build? Traps? Ladders? Trampolines?
    I'm thinking there should be another resource that you build things with. How does something like 'supplies' sound? Trying to stay away from having to collect things like wood, stone, rope separately, and instead just have one type of resource :)
    There needs to be a way to place larger blocks of troops, I'm thinking of making the scroll wheel toggle the size of the 'army block' you can place? (1 troop, 4 troops, 10 troops, 20 etc)
    The menu has 3 button categories, and I'm still trying to figure out what to do with the last one (it's a flag icon right now. My first thought was have it be special 'Troop Commands', like calling for a volley of arrows or a trebuchet strike etc. Which I think would be rad :D OR I'm thinking of splitting up the build category into offensive things and defensive things (traps vs barriers etc)

notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/lLYZWGt.jpg

Unit Orders
Introducing the ability to directly order units! :D you can now hold left ctrl and go into "command mode" where you can select units, then (still holding ctrl) right click and order them to go somewhere/attack/interact with things!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/76154b1f26169971bb28f22ccf972a4bc991eb69.png
For anyone who's heard me talk about tactics in the game, you know I've struggled with what level of control to give to people. ESPECIALLY because the size and scope of Warcube is still kind of murky... like what level of control is useful for when you only have 5 units? Or for when you have 100? Or when you're in a battle? Or when you're at a regular location? Those questions are usually what I think of the most. So what I've tentatively decided to do, is put in RTS styled controls, and then in a few more weeks (hopefully) I'll have put in more GENERAL style controls, like "everyone charge" or "everyone follow me". That sort of thing :) similar to Mount & Blade if anyone has played that. So let me know what feels good, or if you have any fun ideas for things to do with these controls! Like puzzles or challenges, or really anything that would be fun :)

I'll also be working to make the way you interact with things more clear too, like changing color when hovering over things you can interact with, or some way to highlight them. But I need to get some more content in first ;)

Also! Arena is under construction again, things are a bit broken xD

notes.title: Wendar Village + Tactical Mode (WIP) - 0.0.17v4
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/9HMr5la.jpg

Wendar Village
In the heart of the western peninsula lies Wendar Village. Once a crossroads village that thrived off regional agricultural trade, it now lies in ruin and occupation. It's irrigation channels have become defensive moats, and its once lively market and living quarters a display of graves. It's Warling inhabitants live enslaved in cages, they long for freedom, and will gladly fight for any cube who free's them.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/76154b1f26169971bb28f22ccf972a4bc991eb69.png
Super excited to introduce Villages! These are the first of what I've been calling more 'standardized' locations. Or rather, locations that have a somewhat consistent setup to them! Think 'Siege the Castle' or 'Liberate the Village' or 'Open the Gate' - that sort of thing :) Next step will be to test out village upgrades! But I'm waiting to get some things on the map in place (mainly being able to direct peasants to any particular location)

I started working on standardized assets too, which will let me quickly swap out blocked locations walls/buildings to a different theme! :D

Time to Change the Name!

notes.title: EGG HUNT IS LIVE! - 0.0.16v1
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/NENp1Te.jpg

Easter Egg Hunt!
Allllllright Gunters, now's the time! The future of The OASI-- wait.... wrong script. Okay so this is NOT Ready Player One, this is Warcube! :D and while there's ALWAYS many, many regular Easter Eggs to find in Warcube, I've actually added some REAL Easter Eggs for you guys to find :D I've tagged the locations on the map with a floating egg, but that's all I'm saying ;) let me know whether they were easy or hard to find, that way I know how much I need to step up my hiding game :D

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/76154b1f26169971bb28f22ccf972a4bc991eb69.png
Okay so first off, I've missed you guys :) second, It's been a wild month and a half to say the least, and I just want to say thank you to everyone who's been so supportive since the funeral last month, it really means a lot to me. Sorry to go dark for so long, I just really needed some time to lay low. The good news is, I spent a lot of that time remaking a large portion of Warcube! Unfortunately it's the boring part of the game that you usuaallly don't end up seeing, like saving map data, player info, how units are spawned into locations, all that jazz. But the good news is, finally sitting down and doing this is going to REALLY help me moving forward. Before now I'd found myself slowing down making features and content because I knew that the systems I'd originally built into the game, weren't going to hold up if I wanted to add any complexity to it. This is mainly because after a year of development, and getting feedback from you guys, I realized I needed a much more flexible system for organizing the game data so more complex things can happen in the game! Sounds kinda boring, I know, but I promise its cool :D

***MAC BUILD IS USUALLY A DAY LATE, MESSAGE ME IF IT'S LATER THAN THAT***

0.0.16.v1 - 4/01/2018
-----

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/157ebd25aa857802194f155140a5793032841d08.png
GARRISON CHANGES
So I'm going to get ready and start rolling out some new location types on the map soon, I'm thinking Villages will be the first. And this is going to change the way that garrisons work. You wont be able to store units at Forts/Outposts anymore, instead Castles will be the primary place to store units. So in the mean time, your units will just be congregating at the Siege Camp again :) any units that you DID have at the outposts should have been automatically moved to the Old Home Siege Camp!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/2ce05ab99219d9dd463609a90ffd643d9544cd74.png

     I fixed a TON of bugs! But I also created a bunch more in the process of rebuilding things xP so if you DO find something thats broken, definitely let me know ASAP. Also! I *think* that everyones map data should have been brought across no problem, but definitely give a shout if it didnt!


Buff/Nerf/Added:

    WPN, ???
    COS, Body ???
    COS, Hat ???


Check out the #Latest-Update-Discussion on Discord and let me know what you think!

 --> discord.gg/Warcube

The Bottom Paragraph 
BOOM! Welcome to the bottom paragraph, if you can't tell already it's kind of my favorite. Mainly because I silently don't believe anyone reads it, and if you do read it, It makes me feel like I'm actually just getting to talk to you directly :) something I want to start getting better at, is finding ways to get more feedback and have a conversation about it, I've thought about doing a sort of weekly twitch meeting or something, but I'm just not sure what would work best. Let me know if you have any ideas! :D
ːsteamhappyː

-craigz

https://i.imgur.com/6Q2kAAJ.gif

notes.title: Warcubiversary + Fort Mungus - 0.0.15v1
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/zKVfktG.jpg

Fort Mungus
Broadborough Estates was once home to the finest Warling Mead. But following the Red Chaos Rebellion, a certain ruthless captain by the name of 'Hugh Mungus' and his company looted the estate. In a surprising turn of events, instead of the usual loot and torch, he chose to keep the vineyard and reinforce the estate defenses. Humbly dubbing the location 'Fort Mungus'. It's defenses are quite good, though the same could not be said for it's mead anymore.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/76154b1f26169971bb28f22ccf972a4bc991eb69.png
Well! I wanted to have this update along with a LOT of other stuff ready for the anniversary update :) but it just wasnt ready. And if there's even just ONE thing I've learned this past year, it's to slow down a little bit, so that I don't just ship a bunch of broken things :P (seriously, go look at the like 4 updates after launch lol) I genuinely just get too excited to have people play things, it's one of the best feelings :D BUT! I hope you guys enjoy Fort Mungus, it's probably my favorite so far, got a lot of clever things in it - we'll see if you find them! ;D

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary of Warcube!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/kzIV9jW.gif

Wahoo! Can you believe it's been a year already?!

Literally a year ago I was on 60+ hours of no sleep but more thrilled than ever to launch Warcube :D only to then stay up another 12 hours to fix all the bugs I accidentally shipped with :P

Being thankful for all the support you guys give is the biggest understatement

I've been blown away by the awesome community that Warcube has now, and I'm pumped for moving into this next year as I wrap up core functionality and charge into heavy content creation.

Huge shout out to everyone who's been helping make this game the best it can be ːsteamhappyː 

 You'll be getting this sweet 1 year crown as a gift from me!

Look for it in the update that's coming either tomorrow or Monday! :D

I really love you guys, and can't imagine what making Warcube would be like without you!  ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Elder Barrow Gate + Shield Units! - 0.0.12v1
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/a5r8yf9.jpg

Elder Barrow Gate
Introducing the Elder Barrow Gate. Once known as just the 'Elder Gate' when it was a thriving merchant destination between the lowlands and the mountains. It was a hotly contested location during the War, with so many Warlings lost that the barrows were constructed. It is said that spirits from that time still haunt the land, and the undead roam the night.

https://i.imgur.com/TF5J334.gif


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/76154b1f26169971bb28f22ccf972a4bc991eb69.png
Alrighty friends! I started reading Lord of the Rings again, so enjoy a location inspired by the Barrow Downs ;) but really, I've been having a blast working on some super cool new areas and mechanics as well as continuing to work on the City Siege to come :D I know it'll be a busy next few weeks but I'm hoping to get out a few updates before the holidays! Also, the arena is broken right now, I'm fixing it up as we speak and will have it up in just a couple days hopefully :)

***MAC BUILD IS USUALLY A DAY LATE, MESSAGE ME IF IT'S LATER THAN THAT***

-----

Battle Cam after death
After you die in a battle or castle battle, your units will keep fighting! Use WSAD to move the camera around a bit :) (making a button soon to speed up time!)

https://i.imgur.com/npVi1r5.gif

Shield Units/Warbandit
Introducing the Warbandit, a stronger but slower enemy who fights using a shield. Also, Warling Knights now have shields too!

https://i.imgur.com/bi6KT5f.gif

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/f8559ed10c9770ac0de57828b9b318145f6543f4.png

Camera Culling
I'm experimenting with camera culling in the new location, which hides things that the camera doesn't see :) this location is actually pretty big, but I'm excited to see if it helps anyone on a lower spec system at all :D

https://i.imgur.com/4dVGWvo.gif

New Water
It's pretty! That is all!

https://i.imgur.com/hmmfmi5.gif

Squad Follows by Default
Big thanks to @Vortex for letting me know about this! Now when entering a location where a squad is allowed, they'll follow you by default.

https://i.imgur.com/j1xcOMI.gif

Torchable Things!
Now certain props can be lit by the torch! Oh... and there's torches now! :P

https://i.imgur.com/JoWuhXO.gif

Coin Purse!
You can now throw your money at people! Though bandits don't seem to care much... this is a default item. EVERYONE should now have it in their inventories :)

https://i.imgur.com/CkQF4TZ.gif

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/2ce05ab99219d9dd463609a90ffd643d9544cd74.png

PLAYER, I *think* I fixed the bug where you could still jump after dying @everyone

notes.title: Armies & Garrisons! - 0.0.10v1
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/bobPRuN.jpg

Army and Garrisons!
Unit's from owned Outposts walk to the Siege Camp where you can now withdraw/deposit them! You can also store them in Garrisons (outposts/castles) for later use :) in addition, your personal army will now trail behind you on the map! (ignore them going through the ground, still working on that ;))

Dev Update
BOOM! Little did you guys know that Warcube has been broken for the past week and half on my computer while I rework a whole BUNCH of things in the game that I haven't touched for almost a year :) it was actually pretty scary, but now it's (hopefully) all back in working order, with some pretty cool improvements :D I hope that you're able to see the direction things are going, and that it gets you excited! Certain locations can now store units, you can raise a personal army (although mostly just peasants right now) and there's even enemy variance on the map. Things are getting super exciting :D

0.0.10.v1 - 10/23/2017
-----

Noted Additions:
FEATURE, can access garrisons at outposts and the siege camp!
FEATURE, now your personal army trails behind you on the map (gotta fix clipping!)
FEATURE, can reorder unit spawn stack character menu.
FEATURE, new battle setter-upper for skirmishes, makes some nice columns (hopefully)
OPTION, battle size cap option added (still need to work on how reinforcements function though)
CHAR, can now swap your weapons hands with alt+s (ammo swap is still buggy though) @Noobdyroyer
MAP, Locations now have permits, which decide whether you can bring in a squad/army.
GUI, Tooltips in Character menu! Let me know where else is useful! @TheHardew @RogueMyst

Improvements:
GUI, made the changelog in the pause menu wider.
PLAYER, aiming now depreciation to it after holding down too long
LVL, Skyboxes added to most scenes!
LVL, Darkwood Pass, can now hit rope where [SPOILER REDACTED] is ;)
GUI, Iterated on tutorial poppup box (only in some instances)

Audio Improvements!
Remember to report any audio bugs you find as well!

https://i.imgur.com/dA58hxZ.png

    Unit ally voices
    Tactical order sounds
    Flintlock pistol sounds
    Stone dias sound


Look at that sweet buttery smooth army you got!

https://i.imgur.com/NWXkwan.gif

I'm working on adding more units :P but have fun with the peasants while you can! Rumor has it there's now a LARGE bandit army across the river and causing trouble...

This gave me the biggest smile, love seeing the mohawks on the enemies and that one of the units got a nemesis banner! :D

https://i.imgur.com/6wfNAR9.png?1

notes.title: 0.0.9v5 - Sneak Peek! :D
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/eczWdNg.png

Pushing update til next week! But here's a sneak peek! :D
Hi again everyone! Hope you all are doing more than well and are pumped for the weekend! (and for those of you that are already INTO the weekend, hope Saturday's been great ːsteamhappyː)

Dev Update
It's been a super busy past couple weeks, mainly because after the last hotfix I've been ripping apart HUGE chunks of the core game and rebuilding it to support all sorts of super fun stuff in the future :D

I wanted to give you guys a sneak peek, so you can tell just how big of an adjustment this is! As well as let me know anything you might be excited to see with it in the future :) hence the delay til next week!

Armies under your command on the map now look a little different ;)

https://i.imgur.com/3f73VDw.gif

And will look different as they grow!

https://i.imgur.com/TnzRXZ1.gif

You'll also be able to manage them via certain locations!
I'm not entirely sure how this will work in the long run, curious what you guys think, but I'm excited for the opportunities it brings!

https://i.imgur.com/SWKrqhZ.gif

Which also means there's been a big upgrade to the way battles look!
I slowed the spawning down pretty slow for this GIF so you can see them build on, normally they just pop in real quick ;)

https://i.imgur.com/ixIcNbr.gif

I also built this little tool, not sure what I'll use it for... but still! :P

https://i.imgur.com/NbHWbMh.gif

Also a small addition, but I've added depreciative aiming to ranged attacks!
So now if you hold the attack too long it'll start to widen ;) let me know next week if this gets annoying and I can take it out :D

https://i.imgur.com/XPXNFJI.gif

 --> https://discord.gg/kGdPW8z

Also! I know I really do say this every time... 
But if you DO enjoy Warcube in the slightest, be sure to leave a positive review for it on the store page, it would really mean so much to me :) I read every single one! Doesn't even have to be fancy, just a few words would do :D 

ːsteamhappyː

-craigz

https://i.imgur.com/6Q2kAAJ.gif

notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/v9aRPWE.jpg

Rivertoll Outpost!

That's right friends :) the last of this areas Outposts is finally here, Rivertoll Outpost. You know what that means, it's time for me to circle back and continue working on that main castle and siege mode ;) (and a couple other surprises too!)

https://i.imgur.com/gApWAgz.gif

Dev Update
Just wanted to say thanks for all the patience and encouragement, you guys really are the best! :D Anyone watching the update timer probably knows this update was a little late to get out! But the good news is, we're all moved into our new place and I'm no longer sick (caught some sort of plague last week after moving in). So let the full-time development of Warcube commence! :D

0.0.8v1 - 09/14/2017
-----

Noted Additions:
Rivertoll Outpost
Experimental Skybox
Ammobundle Pickups
Explodable Rock Pileups (for walls etc)

Improvements:
OVERALL, I *think* I fixed bug where things were blowing up when rotating the camera/pausing/unpausing :)
OVERALL, Improvement in the way character collision is handled.. which means there SHOULD be less running through wall :P @bartkok134 and @Warlord I'm looking at you guys :P
PLAYER, aiming while using mele weapons is now blocked to a particular horizontal plane, so (hopefully) no more random changing directions!
WPN, picking up a weapon when having hands equipped no longer creates an invisible weapon.
MAP, halved respawn time on Eastern side of map for enemy bands @heyguysifoundausernamethatwasnttaken
WPN, Adjust projectile hitboxes! (let me know about this!)
MISC, Improved kill enemies display on score screen (want to do something cooler with it soon!)
CAM, now can rotate camera to align to certain directions when entering/exiting doors

Audio Improvements!
Remember to report any audio bugs you find as well!

https://i.imgur.com/dA58hxZ.png

    Character menu sounds
    World map battle music
    Prancing Poly Inn music
    Lots of new hittable props
    Rat sounds
    Coin Collecting sound
    Other random small things


DEBUG
GUI - should be error messages now if something unexpected happens!
MAP - tap 'H' to get a readout of all your props current states! @Warlord @DivineExpertise @BobTheSavage	

Bug Fixes:
PROP, dead player *should* no longer be able to activate some props!
CAM, fixed camera locking up and canceling controls in retargeted areas @RyderSJ
CAM/AUD, the audio listener now moves to a predefined place when the camera is retargeted.
GUI, fixed first rune pickup tut image being wrong.
UNIT, enemies now no longer can block ground pound @everyone

Buff/Nerf/Added:
ARM, Tony's suit got a speed nerf ;)
WPN, ADD, Heavy Crossbow to campaign.
ARM, ADD, ??? ;)

Known Issues:
CAM, clipping with tall structures + buildings.
CAM, rotating will sometimes get offset.
Arena, Stats GUI not accurate. Possible leak to main game.
Arena, some pathfinding issues.

@Landshark's 15th Account! Okay so it's their second time winning, but this one was just too good ;)

https://i.imgur.com/VX6dNHB.gif

With a pretty entertaining runner up by @Henbrol ;) to quote: "When you get killed so hard you get sent to the abyss "
-Henbrol (the ded)

notes.title: Moving Update! (0.0.8v1 sneak peek!)
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/iMd391X.jpg

That's a real picture of me today! #nofilter ;)
Hi again friends :) I just want to first say a HUGE thank you to everyone who commented, messaged or sent me a note of encouragement about the move. It's been a LOT more stressful than I thought, mainly because we've been bouncing between living at families houses while our new place is getting ready.

I've been doing my best to keep the updates coming while working hard on my little foldout table in guest bedrooms, but if you've been checking the update timer you'll have noticed I keep pushing it back :/

Which has been no fun! Because as you already know, I like to update and get everyones input and help! :)

So with that, we'll finally begin the actual move into our new place this weekend, then I have to wait til the 5th for internet to get hooked up :) so expect an update shortly after that, and also I'll be back on the forum/discord more :D

Here's a sneak peak at what I've been working on! 

Boat explosions!
The next location is the last outpost for this area, and it features some explosive segments ;)

http://i.imgur.com/2uBOzuC.gif

Lock & Key system!
http://i.imgur.com/FonqXQl.gif

Cut them down!
Some really fun moments in this new Outpost :)

http://i.imgur.com/iK4aDnv.gif

Partial Controller Support!
Whew okay so this ones been a while in the making, and might be missing some functionality when it comes to ranged weapons, but I'm excited to see what you guys think of playing the game with a controller :) 

http://i.imgur.com/8lslFNA.png

Map block out!
Oh also! I shared this on Discord a little bit back, but I started to block in the other areas of the map ;) got some fun things planned, and I'd love to hear your ideas on factions! :D

Come hang out on the Discord sometime!
 --> https://discord.gg/kGdPW8z

http://i.imgur.com/qoFiSDp.jpg

Thanks for being patient with me during the move, I'm excited to be done with it and look forward to an awesome year of working on Warcube with everyone! :D

ːsteamhappyː

-craigz

http://i.imgur.com/pHHYdIi.gif

notes.title: I'm Moving! - BRB! - 0.0.7v3
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/iybzc8Q.jpg

That's right, I'm moving!
Just wanted to give you guys a quick headsup, my wife and I (and the baby, and two dogs!) will be moving this weekend, so look for me next week once we finish the drive :)

Basically we'll be moving away from Seattle, USA for about a year to live somewhere reeeeally cheap in the middle of nowhere back in Illinois. (honestly, the strangest move I've ever done...) 

The plan is to ONLY work on Warcube during the year, so that I'm able to deliver awesome, CONSISTENT updates rather than having to juggle working on the game and other jobs :)

I'm really looking forward to it, it'll definitely be a change of pace, rumor has it the internet is slow, but the place is nice and quiet (and on a very pretty lake!).

Come hang out on the Discord sometime!
 --> https://discord.gg/kGdPW8z

Just wanted to say a BIG thank you to everyone who's reviewed the game :) it really means a lot to me, not only does it help Steam notice the game more, but it's crazy encouraging to me. So if you DO like the game, definitely write a review! Doesnt have to be anything long, even just a couple sentences is really helpful to me! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Map + Battle Update! (Army Nemesis) - 0.0.7v1
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/skR6HuX.jpg

Giving the Map some much needed updating!
So I've finally started added some more functionality to the map, hopefully you'll start to see where I'm going with things ;) First thing you'll notice is that the terrain is pretty different than it was before, it's much lower to the water, which should make things look more normal :P

Now there's different sized parties that roam the map!
Right now there's only 3 different size, but eventually I'd like to add in other hero-led armies as well :)

http://i.imgur.com/n5huQGe.gif

notes.title: THE VOID + BRAWLER CAM + WALL JUMPING + CHAR MENU IN LEVEL - 0.0.5v3*
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/cvtOk65.jpg

Packed with ALL sorts of fun!
Alrighty friends :) I've got what I think is some super fun stuff for this update! Rather than me list it all out, just scroll through them GIFS! Also! Don't forget about the Secret Code at the bottom of the post!

http://i.imgur.com/Z7rqGVS.gif

The Void
Have a new weapon you want to test out? Want to just zone out and murdilate some enemies? Enter the Void. A place between worlds, where your memories and places you've been influence the world around you. Tap 'V' on the Map to automagically go there :)

http://i.imgur.com/dHBoaYl.gif

Brawler Cam
Ever wish you could see the world from a different perspective? Now you can with the all new BRAWL CAM! :D okay but seriously, doesn't Warcube look totally rad like this too?! Tap 'R' to swap between views, they both offer certain advantages :)

***NOTE***
If Brawler Cam isn't working for you, try going to the main menu and clearing your key bindings. Then you can rebind them afterwards :)

http://i.imgur.com/0prbMzI.gif

Wall Jumping
Come on guys, WHY did it take so long for this to make it into the game?! Pull off some super sick moves by wall jumping! (and you can also kindaaa wall run + jump, but it's finicky ːsteamhappyː)

http://i.imgur.com/yEw986m.gif

Character Menu Anytime!
By popular demand! You can now swap equipment whenever you want :) just tap 'C' to go there! (Moved blocking to 'E' and 'MMB') Remember you can do key remapping from the main screen options!

Also, again I know it sounds obvious 
But if you DO enjoy Warcube in the slightest, be sure to leave a positive review for it on the store page, it would really mean so much to me :) it's crazy encouraging to me and doesn't even have to be fancy, just a few words would do :D 

 UPDATE POLLS! 
Do you think the Brawler Cam feature should be a permanent feature?
http://www.strawpoll.me/13153122

Does the Void show promise? (ideally as you complete more locations, it adds more little areas to its procedural list) Plus there's some other fun stuff tied in with it I can't talk about just yet ;D
http://www.strawpoll.me/13153128

notes.title: Back in Action! :D - 0.0.2v5
notes.content:
I'm back! :D

Gosh :) what a wild past couple weeks! I wish I could say I'm well rested... but as many of you already guessed, that's totally not the case since Emery was born :P one of my favorite comments was this...

http://i.imgur.com/UFqeBU1.png
@TheDude1972, you know whats up :P

But I'm just genuinely excited to finally be back at development! A few of you probably already noticed, I started ramping back up this week and have been around the Forum and Discord, always so cool to see new people even just after a couple weeks!

Now here's something crazy for you to ponder though...

Warcube launched just over a month ago.

I have to keep rereading that, because it just doesn't register mentally. Since launch things have been busy, very busy. Definitely in a good way though! Since launch on January 27th there's been...


    22 updates to the game 
    24 Player Suggestion implemented
    117 bugs squashed
232 Discord Members
287 Forum Topics Started
Too many new friends to count :)


In addition! There was also a milestone update featuring the Arena! Which I was super excited to get out right before I had my first kid! :D

GIFOTU @Landshark's 15th Account
So smooth, so jumpy, such a direct hit with that crossbow :P

http://i.imgur.com/DCScigh.gif

-----

Noted Additions:
-Can now attack through dead units.

Experimental Additions:
-PLAYER, pressing parry next to explosive barrels will light them.

Known Issues:
Arena, Stats GUI not accurate. Possible leak to main game.
Arena, some pathfinding issues.
Arena, audio VERY work in progress.

Bug Fixes:
-ARENA, cut certain loading iterations, should speed up resets/loading the arena. @Rob
-ARENA, fixed spawn towers and falling log round.
-PLAYER, fixed iso-orientation not matching up with option settings in arena @John
-PLAYER, after mele attack character realigns itself faster. @Nikita_Krushchevo
-PLAYER, *hopefully* fixed weird bug where picking up a weapon initiated attacking.
-ENEMY, fixed animation bug where they sunk into the ground when blocking.
-Intro, fixed first time startup switch to happen AFTER getting through intro.
-Intro, added Discord to intro icons.

-GUI, *think* I fixed the merchant map name bug on map. @NateRateTheNarrate

-WPN, increased rock collision size.

-LVL, Waterbones, mobs stuck on dock area @Dubstix

notes.title: 0.0.1v14 - Hitreg Update + Aim Assist
notes.content:
Arena SOON!
First off! Sorry for the delay with the arena :) after some feedback from the poll I'm going to be working in a sort of unlockable/upgrade system between rounds. I'm super excited to release this and get some iterations on it :D expect something this week!

Like I said... I'll probably be releasing quite a few arena style game modes over development so that we all can find out what's the most fun :D but gotta start somewhere! :)

I absolutely LOVE seeing arrows getting hit out of the air, but I've never seen someone cut it THIS close to being hit ;D

http://i.imgur.com/7kVt2V5.gif

-----

Additions:
RANGED AIM ASSIST - introducing a *slight* aim assist for ranged weapons to help out with aiming vertically.
AMMO PICKUPO - can now pickup arrows off of dead bodies before they scale out.
HITREG UPDATE - enemy units have improved hitreg on YOU and an attack distance cap.
Jerry's Gate Farmer - says something new as his near parting words ;) thanks to Dokugan!

Known Issues:
KEY REMAPPING: Player facing direction is wrong when changing movement controls.

Bug Fixes:
-LVL, Bollickus Graveyard, fixed wagon/coffin bug. Coffins needed to be rigid bodies! ;D

-MAP, locations that are nuetral have white icons, if found all banners will THEN turn blue.
-PROP, ammo supply crate, I *think* I fixed the bug where it wasn't giving ammo. (again)
-PROP, Arrows, improved pickup radius.

ːsteamhappyː
-craigz

http://i.imgur.com/pHHYdIi.gif

notes.title: JANUARY 27th - EARLY ACCESS
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/yRN6nCe.jpg

Wahoo! It’s true!
January 27th I’ll be releasing Warcube into Steam Early Access :D

It’s taken a ton of work to get to this point. As primarily a solo developer there’s been far too many late nights to count, meals missed and friends who thought I died.

But I’ve had some crazy support to get here, technical and creative help from those same friends, encouragement from many of my new friends online! With an especially big shoutout to the imgur fam, and our absolutely awesome Warcube forum crew right here on Steam :D 

This is the STARTING LINE

And I know it! My aim is to develop Warcube with a community of friends, and use the same excitement that comes from PLAYING games with friends, to MAKING them :) creating a game has been something I’ve wanted to do since childhood, and now that I get to, I want to make it the way I would have back then. With YOU.

I have a vision for Warcube and will always do my best to describe it. But at the same time, how YOU play the game, YOUR feedback, and US talking about it is going to shape how it grows. 
And I value that more than my initial vision.

Early Access makes better games

I firmly believe this, and wouldn’t even dream of doing Early Access unless I did. When people come together to help make a game, everyone wins. The developer gets honest feedback and is able to improve the game before it’s done, while players and friends get the satisfaction of knowing they helped create a BETTER GAME. The game you play on January 27th will probably very different from the final version, and that’s what I want :)

I’m sure I could say a lot more, but I’ll shut up now :) I really care about you guys, and I really care about Warcube. So my hope is that we make Warcube an absolutely incredible game, and that when it leaves Early Access, we can be proud of the work we’ve done. 
So that in 10 years when people look back, they don’t just see a fun game, but a game that was fun to make.

Don’t be a stranger :)
-craigz

P.s. This probably goes without saying, but on January 27th let’s make some noise! Tell anyone who you think might like Warcube about it :) whether they’re your coworker, friend in class, or favorite youtuber/streamer. It’d mean the world to me :)

notes.title: GIFlog #4 Traps, Unit Orders & Stealth Update!
notes.content:
Happy Late Update Everyone! :D
Had a crazy weekend trying to get my builds together, after all, gotta release this month ;) so here's a quick update on things I've been doing!

Functional Traps! (stand in front of logs? You ded!)

Worked on a system for organizing traps, so now I have trip lines and ropes and switches that all trigger different things to happen! For instance, you could have also shot the base of that rope to trigger the log trap :D

http://i.imgur.com/kxEPdyJ.gif

Unit Orders! Attack, Hold Position, Go There

New command ring! It'll highlight units currently under your command. Simple, but makes all the difference :)

http://i.imgur.com/tYlkD6w.gif

Right now you can tell your units to follow you (default), attack, hold position, or tell them where to go. I want to make the orders be super fun too! So for calling for an attack, maybe your character pulls out a rams horn or something? I'm a Lord of the Rings nerd, and I just think battles should always start with a horn! :P

http://i.imgur.com/oovDhRj.gif

Stealth System Update

Guys I've just been so excited for this stealth system! Feels so strange working on things like unit orders AND stealth, then I realize. It all leads to the same glorious destruction and slow motion :P Enemies have some new features, they now..


    Get suspicious of arrows and things like that and will move to investigate.
    Alert others when they're attacked.
    Get surprised when they see you.
    Can block attacks! (been procrastinating on this, not sure why...)


http://i.imgur.com/4438mbc.gif

Still so much to do before Early Access! I finally am started to see the challenge of working on levels and locations vs. making cool features. Hopefully I find that balance soon ;) 

Have a great rest of the week friends!

don't be a stranger!
-craigz


http://i.imgur.com/pHHYdIi.gif

notes.title: GIFLog #3 Highlighting, Explosive Precision & Stealth!!
notes.content:
Happy Weekend Everyone!
What a week! It absolutely flew by for me :) But I got some super fun stuff done! 

Highlighting
So originally when you interacted with weapons and other things, I had a little circle pop up, it was pretty meh... SO I've started integrating a highlighting system like all those fancy games have nowadays :D

http://i.imgur.com/gOkjZUi.gif

Explosive Precision
This ones pretty small... but I was playing the newer Gauntlet this week, and loved that their explosive barrels had little glowy rings around them! It helps you know the rough degree of destruction you're going to create! And helps you line up groups of people to murdilate ;)

http://i.imgur.com/3BTtodG.gif

STEALTH 
Ohhhhhh yes :) I'm super pumped to show you guys this one! I've only just started building the system, there's soooo much more to do still. But you can now hide in bushes (soon to be other places too) and surprise attack enemies! If Skyrim can let you play as a stealth archer then SO CAN I! :P

http://i.imgur.com/SznahJP.gif

(I've also added a little invisible timer for their line of sight, so you have like .4 seconds to move out of it before they see you, it lets you slide between cover like a pro!)

As always! Let me know what you think :D there's so much more to do still, but I'm just so excited to introduce stealth :) it's something I've been wanting in the game for a loooong time :D

Have a great weekend everyone, don't be a stranger!

-craigz

http://i.imgur.com/pHHYdIi.gif

notes.title: GIFLog #2 Weapon Cooldown, Beauty-Pause, & Explorational Level WIP!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

I'm a day late with the updates :D Going to try and get these suckers up on Saturdays, but the Holidays keep throwing me off! :P

Boring! But important, it's weapon cooldowns!
I've been tinkering with weapon stats, and one thing that's become necessary are indicators of weapon cool down :) here's the first pass at it. You're left hand is a blue half circle, while the right is a orangeish one. I've set the battle axe cooldown super high so you can see it build on. Like I said, slightly boring :P *NOTE* If you succesfully initiate a combo by attacking right after you hit an enemy you don't have to cool down then :D

http://i.imgur.com/HVVyWof.gif

Beauty-Pause! Trademark, copyright blah blah blah. Kidding.
Alrighty, so if you pause the game at any point it goes into slow mo, cool, but been done before. But if you click the eyeball in the top right corner (or just double tap esc when you go to pause) it'll hide the UI and you can bask in your destructive glory :D don't mind my debug text telling you to hit the box... :P

http://i.imgur.com/ChSeBUm.gif

Explorational Level WIP
Okay, might be tricky to look at this one, go  HEREif it's giving you trouble in the Steam browser. But it's a hi-res image capture of an explorational location! Pretty WIP still! But it gives a good idea of what some locations are all about :) don't worry, there's still enemies to bash and stuff ;)

http://i.imgur.com/WehXDfG.jpg

That's all for this week :D still so much to do now that it's officially January! But I'm building out a ton of locations and hopefully going to ship with somewhere between 12-22 of them. And fingers crossed to end the area on on a big castle battle :D

You guys rock :D hope you all had a great new years! Or stayed at home and played games like me :P

-craigz ːsteamhappyː

http://i.imgur.com/pHHYdIi.gif

I may or may not do community shoutouts in the future... I feel bad not being able to include everyone, my mid-west roots are starting to show :P

http://i.imgur.com/i9IaA80.jpg

notes.title: Release Update Announcement!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/2ec92a0a11aa5c29c79ac40bdf4ccf4b7a58690e.gif

Hi friends! Yes that IS what I look like above ;)

I wanted to give an update on release! But before I get rolling...

TL;DR RELEASING JANUARY 2017

Why the delay? Who am I? EA or Ubisoft?! Not at all, just me! ːsteamhappyː

It's been a wild past couple months since PAX and I've been really moving forward with the game. I can't thank you guys enough for the support :)

I had the awesome opportunity to go to Steam Dev Days a couple weeks back.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/f4d9a2c144ccd864e4bfb6e7d3095ee5a8cb2168.jpg

While there I heard some incredible talks from people who are WAY smarter than me. They recommended to stay away from releasing anytime from October - December. Instead, continue building the game, polishing what I have and releasing after the holiday madness.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/2f4dd4abb89c3146127e309831ce6481f50c8403.jpg

 And I believe that's the right thing to do :) 

So I'm going to keep drilling away on the game, adding new things and am more excited than ever to get everyone playing in January 2017 :) 

What better way to start the new year out, right?  ːsteamhappyː

Also I'm starting a new thing for updates!

It's called 'Community Shoutout'! Where I thank people in the community. This can come in a variety of forms: from encouragement, starting a popular discussion, even just leaving a clever comment ;) 

I'd like to have something eventually to give people IN GAME, but am not sure what yet. Just one of the small ways I want to say thank YOU! ːsteamhappyː

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/fb7ad6d70e4c35e6ddad58cce3e1b5d811af4d00.jpg

I've been having so much fun making this game, lots of sleepless nights and early mornings. But couldnt be happier :D

Don't hesitate to give a shout if you have any questions or just want to say hi, I've enabled my notifications on comments, so I'll be sure to get back to you :D

-craigz

notes.title: PAX Roundup :)
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/b9592d86fab8333e439aee6391cf6f355183f888.jpg

In short, It was incredible. 	

It absolutely pushed my limits in a million different ways, and all of them good.

I met some REALLY awesome people, some that I've only known online (in fact, MOST) and the best part was meeting someone is real life, and realizing they're JUST as cool as they were in your head :D

Setup went great, and I honestly couldn't have gotten a better spot. I was setup on a corner, RIGHT next to the Capcom/Resident Evil booth! (and next to them, Behemoth!!) And nearly 20 steps away was the main Twitch stage. So I got super consistent foot traffic and tons of curious eyes :)

Booth during setup hours. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/460617fd8abbec8f14481a70abe9762344e40e8c.jpg

The showfloor before opening really cold, probably to get ready for the massive amount of people coming in soon :P

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/728b9710c24f8972d5278be2d98d177053d9b20e.jpg

Warcube even got on the main Twitch stream for a few minutes, and we got to show it off sitting right next to Rami Ismail and Garnett Lee! :D Ahh! Craziness! :)

There were two stations setup to play Warcube, and on more than one occasion there were lines to play. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/e1f94ba764aaaac7ce19f8f17697b56d50b3e4bd.jpg

LINES! To play a little indie game about cubes fighting and slow-motion! It was insane! :)

As an aside, standing the whole day was actually wayyy harder than I thought, turns out sitting in a chair and hardly moving for the past couple years hasn't been great for me! :P But seriously, nothing to complain about.

Topping it off, my voice was completely shot by the last day. I literally sounded like Jeff Bridges. It was beautiful.

I just wanted to say another big thank you to everyone, for putting up with my random gifs, commenting and encouraging me, and keeping me pumped! It truly means a lot to me :)

-craigz
